## Activity

During October 2022, River Outreach completed 56 captures. This activity provides the basis for reviewing the site’s image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The capture total should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the results available for review.

## Image quality

Image graders found 5 captures ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 8.9 of all captures. These images could not be used for a grading outcome. Recurring camera issues should be recorded with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the usual support process.

## Grading

The grading review identified 3 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 0. Together, these measures summarise the site’s grading activity for October 2022 and support routine monitoring of service performance. Any ongoing image-quality concerns should continue to be documented consistently, including the relevant capture details and the action taken.
